scope: Make production-reachable mobile conceal detection resolve players through the authenticated equipped-weapon PRE-CU combat level while preserving authored NPC creature levels, camouflage and detection modifiers, retained later content, and retired post-NGE Spy player gameplay.

findings: Publish 14.1 Ranger conceal and Scout mask scent are skill-mod mechanics that remain production gameplay.
Pinned Core3 mobile camouflage detection compares the equipped-weapon PRE-CU player level with the detecting creature's authored level; it does not consume an NGE visible player combat level.
Pinned Core3 calculates that internal player value from private_<equipped weapon type>_combat_difficulty divided by 100 plus one and caps it at 25.
The authenticated project helper xp.getPrecuCombatLevel already implements the same player-versus-NPC boundary and is distinct from retained-content encounter difficulty.
